title: LTS support contract and staggered rollout schedule for Runtime/API/SDK/Console
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Define a single-source LTS support contract and an operational rollout schedule that covers Runtime, Public API, official SDKs, and Console UI. Deliverables: support matrix artifact, gated rollout checklist, automation for LTS branch/tag creation, and a deprecation communication timeline. Align semantic guarantees across components while minimizing customer upgrade friction.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Published support matrix doc in Confluence with per-component timelines; 2) Rollout gate checklist (canary, SLO, logs) stored in repo release-infra/rollout-gates; 3) Automation PRs to tag LTS releases and create release branches for runtime and SDKs; 4) Console feature-flag plan and migration window documented; 5) Cross-team sign-offs from Product, Security, and Developer Experience.
notes: Key trade-offs: longer LTS increases maintenance cost; shorter LTS raises upgrade frequency for customers. Proposal: asymmetric LTS windows to balance risk and maintenance: runtime 18 months; API stable endpoints 24 months; SDKs 12 months; Console 12 months. Use a compatibility contract to allow documented non-breaking additions and clarify breaking-change process.

implementation_steps: Finalize support matrix schema and publish Confluence doc
Implement rollout-gate checks in release-infra (canary, SLO, errors, saturation)
Add automation to create LTS release branches and tag builds
Wire Console to show deprecation banners and migration pages
Coordinate external communications (status page, blog post, customer emails)
risks: Maintenance burden if LTS windows are too long leading to patch backlog
Breaking schema changes in API could force emergency migration if not gated
Private deployments may lag behind hosted API causing customer confusion
proposed_decision: Adopt asymmetric LTS durations (runtime:18m, API:24m, SDKs:12m, Console:12m) with explicit deprecation and migration windows. Enforce rollout gates for all LTS releases including canary SLO pass, <1% error delta, and automated rollback on regression.
